text:
Hi everyone! I’ve addressed issue #671 in <https://github.com/datazip-inc/olake/pull/1343|PR #1343> by adding denormalized integration tests for MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB, covering full refresh, CDC, and incremental sync across Iceberg Legacy, Iceberg Arrow, and Parquet.
All three database tests have passed. Could someone please review the PR and share feedback? Thanks!
